## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of customer-managed CAs, TPM/TEE attestation mechanisms, and per-tenant isolation within Key Certificate Authority (KCA) architectures. It also assesses knowledge of policy streaming protocols and offline revocation strategies.

## Key Concepts
- Tenant-owned root certificate authorities
- TPM/TEE hardware-based attestation
- SPIFFE-like identity frameworks
- Short TTL certificates and automatic rotation
- Per-tenant policy streaming mechanisms
- Revocation protocols (OCSP/CRL) and comprehensive auditing

## Code Example
```yaml
enrollment:
  attestation: tpm_tee
  certificate_ttl: 15m
  identity_format: spiffe-like
  policy_streaming: per-tenant
  revocation:
    primary: ocsp
    fallback: crl
```
